content: As introduced earlier, BERT has shown an outstanding performance in NERC-like tasks, improving the start-of-the-art results for almost every dataset and language. We take the same approach here, by using the model BERT-Base Multilingual Cased with a Fully Connected (FC) layer on top to perform a fine-tuning of the whole model for an anonymisation task in Spanish clinical data.
